evidence.detail: Recovered semantic source map identifies rs/gui/b/h as rs.gui.loadouts.LoadoutsPanel.
Exact v308 class extends the shared side-panel base and owns LoadoutFolders, LoadoutStore, EquipmentPanel, list selector, popup menu, stat editor and loadout actions.
The panel directly composes the already-reviewed loadout definition/folder/persistence/equipment family and is the live top-level Swing presentation surface for those models.

proposals.note: Source-proven Loadouts GUI panel. This is the only retained R404 proposal; the other attempted R404 source-name upgrades overlapped existing owners and remain correction evidence only.
